theme.base: Deep Obsidian kaala and blood red brand palette for JEELIVE.AI

cardAnatomy.principle: Ek card, ek baat: bada number, neeche ek seedhi line.
cardAnatomy.container: bg-[#130A0E] border border-[#2D1520] rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-lg shadow-black/40 min-w-0 overflow-hidden
cardAnatomy.tile: bg-[#1A0F15] border border-[#2D1520] border-l-4 rounded-xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 flex flex-col gap-1 transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5

heroComposition.layout: Grid with score ring on left/top (220px ring container) and 4 prominent metric tiles on right/bottom (Rank, Percentile, Accuracy, Time).
heroComposition.scoreRing: Recharts PieChart innerRadius 68 outerRadius 88 with animated red arc (#E11D48) on track (#22131B), bold score centered in Roboto Mono, subtitle out of total marks.
heroComposition.verdictLine: Single high-contrast statement below hero giving clear marks ledger (earned, negative loss, marks left on table).
heroComposition.marksLedger: 4 quick audit chips: +Marks Earned (Green), -Negative Penalty (Red), Left on table (Amber), Net Final (White/Red).

stickyBottomBar.desktop: Sticky at bottom z-40 bg-[#130A0E]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#2D1520] py-2 px-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4
stickyBottomBar.mobile390px: Sticky at bottom z-40 bg-[#130A0E]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#2D1520] py-2 px-3 flex flex-col gap-2 w-full
stickyBottomBar.switch: Pill toggle group between Personal (User icon) and Comparative (Users icon) with smooth background transition.
stickyBottomBar.sectionsNav: Horizontally scrollable ribbon with no scrollbar, 8 numbered pills (1 Overview to 8 Qs by Qs) with active highlight in blood red (#E11D48).

specializedVisuals.speedAccuracyScatter: 2D quadrant scatter map: X-axis time spent vs Par (Fast to Slow), Y-axis outcome (Correct vs Wrong vs Skipped). Each question is a tappable dot opening drawer/solution.
specializedVisuals.journeyChips: Time-block chronological pills (0-30m, 30-60m, etc.) displaying visit number (2nd, 3rd), outcome icon, flag mark, time spent, and answer shift notation.
specializedVisuals.questionGridHeatmap: Compact responsive grid of question numbers (1 to 75/90) color-coded by correctness (Green/Red/Gray) with border intensity representing peer difficulty.
specializedVisuals.scoreWaterfall: Score Potential waterfall step-chart showing current score + Careless mistakes recovered + Risky guesses dropped + Reinvested time = Realistic Target & Max Potential.
specializedVisuals.comparativeVisuals: Side-by-side gap breakdown: You vs Topper/Top 10%/Class Avg with subject differential delta bar and Pace curve comparison overlay.

motionAndInteractions.sectionSwitch: Framer-motion or CSS @keyframes a2-in: fade in with 8px upward slide (0.24s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
motionAndInteractions.barFill: Progress bars and metric meters smoothly ease-in width over 450ms.
motionAndInteractions.touchGestures: Horizontal swipe on 360-390px screens navigates between consecutive sections without blocking vertical table scroll.
motionAndInteractions.microInteractions: Tap lift on tiles (-2px hover), active press state on chips and question dots.

emptyAndLockedStates.style: Subtle dashed border box in #2D1520 with warm amber/slate warning icon and encouraging Roman Hinglish copy.
emptyAndLockedStates.cohortLock: Abhi 3 students ne diya hai, 10 par rank aur topper data khulega.
emptyAndLockedStates.timingLock: Is attempt mein per-question time record nahi hua. Agle mock se shuru hoga.

top5WowDetails.1: Instant Marks Ka Hisaab: A visual financial-ledger style breakdown of marks earned, negative marks thrown away, and easy marks left on table.
top5WowDetails.2: Speed-Accuracy Matrix Dot Plot: Interactive scatter showing whether errors came from rushing (careless) or dragging in overtime.
top5WowDetails.3: Realistic Score Target Calculator: One-tap waterfall simulating 'Agar careless galtiyan aur mushkil sawaal chhod dete to aapka score +36 marks aur rank #420 hoti'.
top5WowDetails.4: Question Journey Replay: Visual breadcrumb showing which questions were revisited, where answers were flipped from right to wrong, and time blocks spent.
top5WowDetails.5: Zero-Lag Mobile Navigation: Tactile sticky bottom bar with Personal vs Comparative mode switcher and scroll-locked horizontal data tables.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain all existing testing data-testid attributes (a2-bottom-bar, a2-mode-personal, a2-mode-compare, a2-score-ring, a2-tile-*, etc.) to pass regressions.
Ensure .js files (not .tsx) are used in frontend.
On mobile viewports (360px-390px), wide tables must scroll horizontally within .a2-scroll without breaking the outer viewport.
Keep dark theme colors consistent using #090507, #130A0E, and blood red #E11D48 accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or low-contrast washed gray surfaces.
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG contrast: bright crisp text (#F8FAFC, #9AA8BA) over dark surfaces (#130A0E).
Include data-testid on every interactive button, tab, card, and metric tile.
Do not apply global transition: all. Use specific transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease.
